cleanup: Always stop owned transient unit; verify inactive or not-found and observed cgroup absent or populated0. KillMode control-group. No persistent install.
cleanup_deadline_scope: 120-second interaction deadline; bounded stop/property/reap cleanup may add up to bounded control-query time. No further model attempt.
correction: Broken pipe retains actual bytes sent; COMPLETE requires entire gate+prompt written. Prior runner and controls retained.
input: one-byte gate followed by prompt, nonblocking; wall starts before Popen; cgroup memory inspected before gate
trust: Local systemd/kernel enforcement on trusted host; not provider authentication. Existing HOME used for existing login, no credential copied or logged.
